blocks.content: DigiLocker and the Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance (UMANG) are digital public platforms under the Digital India programme. As of 31 July 2026, DigiLocker had more than 72.43 crore registered users, while UMANG had more than 11.66 crore registered users.

items: Digital India was launched in July 2015 as a Government of India programme.
DigiLocker is associated with paperless service delivery and digital document storage.
UMANG stands for Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance.
Common Service Centres operate as last-mile digital service delivery points in rural India.
